purpose: Exact declared architecture-debt ledger. Each entry enumerates concrete file paths for a dependency-direction violation that exists at the refactor base and that the target boundary policy forbids. This ledger is not an allowlist: reconciliation asserts exact set equality against the live scan, so an undeclared equivalent violation, a new importer, a different path, a value-edge upgrade, or a stale entry all fail.

debts.risk: app/lib/tenant/types.ts is a hybrid: it re-exports canonical tenant identity types from app/lib/domain/tenant/types.ts while also being the sole physical owner of Actor, TenantContext, TenantBoundaryResult, assertTenantBoundary, requireTenantContext and createAnonymousDevelopmentTenantContext. Domain therefore depends upward on a compatibility module. The module has the highest fan-in in the repository, every observed edge is type-only, and the runtime helpers have no verified call sites, so the eventual split is expected to be behaviour-free. Building a new canonical domain family on this shape would propagate the inversion into that family.
debts.removal_gate: Relocate TenantContext, Actor, TenantBoundaryResult and the tenant-boundary helpers into the domain layer, repoint every importer, and remove this entry so the domain policy passes with no declared debt. WU-01 may not introduce the canonical domain record family on top of this hybrid without resolving it or recording an explicit PM re-scope.

debts.risk: Provider read-boundary mappers depend on an application-layer type, inverting the intended direction infrastructure -> ports/domain. The shared normalized signal contract currently has no domain or port home, so every new provider adapter would reproduce the inversion.
debts.removal_gate: Relocate the normalized signal contract into a domain or port boundary, repoint the three provider mappers and any application consumers, and remove this entry so the external-client policy passes with no declared debt.
